subject.title: Video-generation providers fetch the result URL with no SSRF guard (byteplus, minimax, xai, runway, vydra)

question: Should this public SSRF report stay in the normal provider-hardening path, or should maintainers move the remaining discussion and implementation into private security handling?
rationale: The source path appears real and security-sensitive, but the disclosure and handling model for compromised-provider or custom-endpoint SSRF is a maintainer security-boundary decision.

options.title: Fix publicly as provider hardening
options.body: Keep this issue open publicly and land a focused guarded-download fix with default-deny SSRF regression tests for the affected providers.

options.title: Escalate to private security handling
options.body: Move implementation details and any additional proof into the security process if maintainers judge the threat model to need coordinated disclosure.

options.title: Coordinate partial provider PRs
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker while provider-specific PRs are corrected or replaced until all five affected paths are covered.

recommendation.title: Fix publicly as provider hardening
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open publicly and land a focused guarded-download fix with default-deny SSRF regression tests for the affected providers.

likelyOwner.reason: Current affected lines and earlier video provider support most consistently trace to steipete-authored history, and this is the best available routing owner from the code provenance.
